decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine was launched only in 2024 and its value is still unresolved; it fits the firm's automation strategy and keeps the option open after the earlier robots were consolidated, though the quick removal of those 2023 robots shows the firm prunes its robot line readily.

The production analysis software costs little to keep on the market, complements the firm's control and lifecycle services, and its uncertain but potentially high value from digitalized precast production justifies holding the option.
